excerpt.rendered: In the ongoing, collaborative effort to make Sherwood School District a great place for all kids, the Technology Department dedicates itself to serve all members of the district by supporting the use of technology both in and out of the classroom as well as sustaining the district through continually evolving and expanding technological innovations.
